mapper.select: SELECT PGM_NO AS pgmNo , PGM_ID AS pgmId , PGM_NM AS pgmNm , PGM_GO AS pgmGo , PARENT_PGM AS parentPgm , PGM_KIND_CODE AS pgmKindCode , SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder , UPD_ID AS updId FROM FW_PGM_MST WHERE PGM_KIND_CODE = 'M' AND PARENT_PGM = '00000' AND MENU_USE_YN = 'Y' AND PGM_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER

SELECT PGM_NO AS pgmNo , PGM_ID AS pgmId , PGM_NM AS pgmNm , PGM_GO AS pgmGo , PARENT_PGM AS parentPgm , PGM_KIND_CODE AS pgmKindCode , SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder , TREE_LEVEL AS treeLevel , TREE_LINE AS treeLine , FULLPGM AS fullpgm , FULLPGM1 AS fullpgm1 , FULLPGM2 AS fullpgm2 FROM FW_PGM_MST WHERE PGM_KIND_CODE IN ('M', 'P') AND MENU_USE_YN = 'Y' AND PGM_USE_YN = 'Y' AND PARENT_PGM != '00000' START WITH PGM_NO = #{pgmNo} CONNECT BY PRIOR PGM_NO = PARENT_PGM ORDER SIBLINGS BY NVL(SORT_ORDER, 0)

SELECT PGM_NO AS pgmNo , PGM_ID AS pgmId , PGM_NM AS pgmNm , PGM_GO AS pgmGo , FULLPGM AS fullpgm , FULLPGM1 AS fullpgm1 , FULLPGM2 AS fullpgm2 FROM FW_PGM_MST WHERE UPPER(PGM_ID) = UPPER(#{pgmId}) AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT PGM_NO AS pgmNo , PGM_ID AS pgmId , PGM_NM AS pgmNm , PGM_GO AS pgmGo , PARENT_PGM AS parentPgm , PGM_KIND_CODE AS pgmKindCode , SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder , FULLPGM AS fullpgm , FULLPGM1 AS fullpgm1 , FULLPGM2 AS fullpgm2 FROM FW_PGM_MST WHERE PGM_KIND_CODE = 'P' AND MENU_USE_YN = 'Y' AND PGM_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY NVL(SORT_ORDER, 0), PGM_GO
